slices.focus: Pilot shelf check reveals dozens of location mismatches, forcing temporary movement controls and a signed relocation log
slices.summary: The pilot shelf check discovers dozens of objects where database, tag, and box label all disagree — Hannah immediately mandates a signed relocation log before any object leaves a rack and a temporary hold process for discrepancies.
open_loops: Draft one-page hold instruction sheet (trigger -> hold -> document -> resolve -> release)
Keep relocation log narrow (who moved what, from where, when — separate from research notes)
Send short explanatory note upward explaining the control change and evidence basis
Stop apologizing when introducing new forms
